messages:
Rae Collins: Heads-up 1 ACME renewal flagged latency spikes during a weekend ramp. Can we make a one-page customer "Activation Health Card" they can run in a 15-min call?
Tom Owens: Yes 1 keep it action-first: 5 quick checks, one curl example, one jitter schedule, 3 plain metrics, and a simple color health legend.
Priya Singh: Metric names for customers: prefill_hit_pct, stream_median_ms, pending_requests_count. Recommend alarms too (we'll give numbers).
Tom Owens: Quick checks I'll draft: 1) Prefill top 8 prompts (one-off); 2) Enable jittered prefill schedule; 3) Set batch size 2-4 for low latency; 4) Client timeout ~10-12s then fallback to streaming with max_chunk_tokens=64; 5) Cache TTLs: ephemeral=5m, session=1h, static=12h.
Lina Moradi: Renewal note: if prefill_hit_pct < 60% AND stream_median_ms > 800ms for 48h -> recommend temporary warm pool or dedicated capacity. Include booking link for rapid troubleshooting.
Tom Owens: One-line curl customers can copy:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"tenant":"ACME","prompts":["welcome","summary"],"parallel":2}'
```
Jitter suggestion: schedule every 5m + rand(-30s..30s).
Priya Singh: Health legend (copyable): GREEN = prefill_hit_pct >= 75% AND stream_median_ms < 500ms; YELLOW = prefill_hit_pct 50-75% OR stream_median_ms 500-800ms; RED = prefill_hit_pct < 50% OR stream_median_ms > 800ms OR sustained 5xx.
OpsBot: Draft uploaded internally: https://confluence.redwood.ai/cs/activation-healthcard-draft (internal). Replace ops emails with support@redwood.ai for public copy.
Lina Moradi: Public escalation: email support@redwood.ai with tenant_id, expected peak qps and ramp window; for urgent help book: https://cal.com/redwood-cs/30.
Rae Collins: Nice. Add a tiny feedback gadget idea: thumbs up / thumbs down + one-line "what changed" so CS can capture post-action notes for renewal playbook.
Tom Owens: I'll produce the one-pager and a 2-sentence customer email template. Priya will give alarm snippets. Aim to publish by tomorrow morning.
Rae Collins: Thanks team 1 short, practical, customer-facing. Closing thread; will post final link here when published. :white_check_mark:
